_readme: Hand-edited trip details. Edit this file, then run: node scripts/build-data.mjs

base.name: The Airbnb
base.title: FACES of Jungle-Funky design in vibrant centre
base.near: the Király utca tram stop (trams 4 and 6)
base.access: Self check-in with a lockbox. The instructions come through the Airbnb app.
base.note: On Erzsébet körút, the Grand Boulevard, at the Király utca end: trams 4 and 6 stop outside, and Lemezkuckó record shop is round the corner. The booking doesn't give a house number yet, so the pin is a close guess.

items.title: Land at Budapest Airport
items.sub: Ryanair FR1023 from Dublin (departs 08:25 Irish time). Terminal 2.

items.title: Check in at the Airbnb
items.sub: Self check-in with a lockbox from 15:00, on Erzsébet körút by the Király utca tram stop. You land at 12:20, so grab lunch first or ask the host about dropping bags early.

items.title: Ferencváros v Viktoria Plzeň
items.sub: Europa League at Groupama Aréna. Kick-off 21:00 (20:00 home time).

items.title: Check out of the Airbnb
items.sub: Out by 10:00, and you're due at the airport for 14:45. Ask the host to mind the bags, or use a luggage-storage app (Bounce or Radical Storage) for the gap.

items.title: Be at Budapest Airport
items.sub: Terminal 2, two hours before FR1026 departs.

items.title: FR1026 to Dublin departs
items.sub: Lands in Dublin at 18:55 Irish time.

flights._readme: Flight numbers and times. Budapest times are local (CEST); Dublin times are Irish time, one hour behind. The booking reference is deliberately NOT stored here because this site is public.
